label: Model estimates
method: Momentum is a decayed z-score of recent games against the player's own prior average (half-life 3 games), stepped by 1% and capped at 5%. Rate stats (yards per attempt, carry, or target) count less when the recent volume is light. The defense multiple blends the shrunk yards-allowed factor with that defense's recent trend, also inside 5%. The net multiple adds the two nudges and stays inside 8%. It scales the pipeline's pre-game projection. Weeks 9–12 are the holdout. A position is flagged when the net multiple does not lower absolute error there.
